name: project
text: The loop fakes stand acceptance cases in as .txt markers and invent their result rows: a feature that reads the case source (its AST or file) needs a fake verifier action that writes a real .py case file and a fake worker action that edits it, and a feature about a new result status needs a marker in fake_tests.py's case_row - until the test interface knows a status, it refuses the row as unmeasured.
